description: This Java source file defines a generic caching utility class 'UtilCache' implementing a sophisticated cache with features such as size limits, expiration, soft references, and event listeners. It manages cache entries, handles eviction policies, and provides methods for cache manipulation and statistics.

classes.name: UtilCache
classes.description: A thread-safe, configurable caching utility with features like size limit, expiration, soft references, and event listeners. Supports cache statistics and eviction handling.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a cache entry with optional expiration time.

methods.name: putIfAbsent
methods.description: Inserts a cache entry only if the key is not already present.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry by key, updating hit/miss counters.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the cache.

methods.name: setExpireTime
methods.description: Sets the expiration time for cache entries.

methods.name: getExpireTime
methods.description: Returns the current expiration time setting in milliseconds.

methods.name: setUseSoftReference
methods.description: Enables or disables soft references for cache entries.

methods.name: getUseSoftReference
methods.description: Returns whether soft references are being used.
